storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP DreamCamVR Downloader makes it easy to record live streams and download saved recordings from DreamCamVR (dreamcamtrue.com).

How it works: Go to any model page on DreamCamVR while the stream is live, open the extension popup or click the download button on the player. The extension discovers the HLS stream across multiple CDN hosts, shows available quality options, and lets you start a live capture. When you're done, hit Stop — the captured stream is converted to a standard MP4 file.

For saved recordings (VOD), navigate to the video page and download directly — the extension fetches the video URL from the DreamCam API.

It handles LL-HLS live capture, Mouflon-encrypted manifests, VR camera metadata, and multi-CDN host discovery automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required.

Key features:
- Live stream capture with start/stop controls and real-time segment counting
- VR camera metadata support (stereo packing, frame format, viewing angle)
- Multi-CDN host discovery (doppiocdn, stripcdn, sc-cdn, and more)
- Mouflon-encrypted manifest decoding
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Real-time download progress with speed and segment indicators
- Right-click context menu for quick captures
- Desktop notifications when captures complete
- Dark-themed UI with coral pink accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to DreamCamVR and open a model page while live
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. Select quality and hit Start — stop when ready

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited captures.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I record a live stream?
faq.answer: Go to any model page on DreamCamVR while the stream is live. Open the extension popup or click the download button on the player. Select your quality and click Start. The extension captures the stream in real-time. Click Stop when you want to finish — the captured stream converts to MP4.

faq.question: Can I download saved recordings (VOD)?
faq.answer: Yes. Navigate to a model's video page (e.g. /username/videos/12345) and the extension will detect the recording and offer it for download.

faq.question: Does it support VR streams?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension detects VR camera settings (stereo packing, frame format, horizontal angle) and includes them in the VR badge and filename suffix.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension parses the HLS master manifest and shows all available resolutions with frame rate info. Formats are sorted by quality (highest first).

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All captures are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited captures.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why does it say the model is offline?
faq.answer: The model needs to be actively streaming for live capture. If the model is offline or in a private show, wait for the public stream to resume.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Stream processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
